cohort: A 33-year-old G2P0+1 woman at 39 weeks' gestation presenting with significant bilateral lower limb oedema and suspicious cardiotocographic features.
finding: Uterine torsion, specifically levorotation, was diagnosed intraoperatively during an emergency Caesarean section prompted by suspicious CTG findings, leading to successful maternal and neonatal recovery after delivery via a posterior uterine incision.
mod_finding: Uterine torsion was diagnosed and managed during an emergency Caesarean section.
